channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas County homeowners see increase in mosquito issues
item.description: After two cases of dengue fever were confirmed in Hillsborough County, homeowners in Pinellas are raising concerns about mosquito breeding grounds in their own neighborhoods.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lakeland auto shop pushes for answers after flooding, but any fix could be years away
item.description: Nearly a week after heavy rain flooded a Lakeland auto shop, its owners say they're still searching for answers about why it happened and whether anything will be done to prevent it from happening again.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa company reflects on groundbreaking of Spaceship Earth 45 years later
item.description: It was the summer of 1981 that Bob Clark and his family at Tampa Steel Erecting Company broke ground on Spaceship Earth turning out to be one of the most iconic structures ever built.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Long-waited relief headed to thousands of student loan borrowers
item.description: If you're among the hundreds of thousands of student loan borrowers out there, long-awaited relief could be on the way.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 5 arrested after drug-trafficking bust on group in Pasco County tied to Sinaloa Cartel: FBI Tampa
item.description: FBI Tampa said it was able to disrupt drug trafficking organization operating out of Pasco County on Wednesday morning.
